InteractionContract.description:
Versioned, persistable UI/action contract owned by Runtime.

The contract deliberately cannot describe password controls or secret
fields. Connector authentication is represented only by safe lifecycle
actions and a backend-owned public status.
InteractionContract.title: InteractionContract

InteractionProjection.description: Safe interaction card returned to the WebUI.
InteractionProjection.title: InteractionProjection

JobProjection.description:
Safe Web projection of a durable job.

Lease fencing data, checkpoints, idempotency keys, raw payloads, worker
identity, heartbeat details, and raw failures are Runtime-internal and can
never cross this contract.
JobProjection.title: JobProjection

ConnectorLoginCheckResponse.description: One exhaustive state projection for connector-login polling.
ConnectorLoginCheckResponse.title: ConnectorLoginCheckResponse

ContextUsageProjection.description: Latest provider-reported context and the selected model threshold.
ContextUsageProjection.title: ContextUsageProjection

TokenUsageWindow.description:
Provider-reported token totals for one calendar window.

The Runtime deliberately does not estimate token counts in the WebUI. A
zero means that no completed model response reported usage in the window;
it is not a proxy for a configured quota.
TokenUsageWindow.title: TokenUsageWindow

ConversationUsageProjection.description: Read-only usage projection for the active conversation composer.
ConversationUsageProjection.title: ConversationUsageProjection

EventEnvelope.description: One immutable fact in a thread's ordered event stream.
EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope

InputAttachmentProjection.description:
Safe, opaque reference to a user-selected input file.

Input attachments are internal source Artifacts.  Their identities may be
attached to a Turn, but they never enter the office deliverables list.
InputAttachmentProjection.title: InputAttachmentProjection
